title: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026 disclosing a Seventh Modification Agreement to its existing credit facility with U.S. Bank National Association. The amendment provides lender consent for the company's pending merger with Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. and revises the Change in Control definition to accommodate Sumitomo acquiring majority ownership.
key_points: Tri Pointe Homes entered into Seventh Modification Agreement to its Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated March 29, 2019.
Administrative agent and lenders consent to, and waive defaults related to, the contemplated merger with Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd.
Merger Agreement was dated February 13, 2026 with Sumitomo Forestry and Teton NewCo, Inc.
Credit Agreement definition of 'Change in Control' revised to include failure of Sumitomo to own more than 50% of voting stock or direct management.
Signed by CFO Glenn J. Keeler on April 17, 2026.
